McNeese State University Class Search  Aug 08, 2026  
The tool below should be used to search classes offered at McNeese State University.

Please enter your search criteria below. You may enter as many limiting factors as needed to narrow the number of classes returned, although no fields are required to search the database. After making your selections, scroll down and click the "Class Search" button. If no selections are made to restrict the data, the entire class listing will be returned. To perform a new search, scroll back to the top, click the word "Reset" and begin again.

Please note if there are no courses that fit the search criteria, you will get a message stating "Unable to locate matching courses." You will need to refine your search and try again.

Be sure to scroll to the bottom of the screen after clicking the "Class Search" button to see your results, and allow adequate time for the search tool to return the classes.



Below are Possible ATTR codes that may be associated with a class.
  • OER (Open Educational Resource): A resource that is in the public domain or has been released under an intellectual property license that permits the free use, adaptation, and redistribution of the resource by any person.

  • AER (Affordable Educational Resource): A single or collection of required resources that may be offered at no or low cost to a student at a pre-sales tax cost that does not exceed an amount equal to four times the federal minimum wage.
